attributes.description: Tier 2 detail dashboard scoped to a single Google Cloud Run service (cloud_run_revision) from metrics-gcp.cloudrun.otel-default. Reached by drilling down from [GCP OTel] Cloud Run Overview via resource.attributes.service_name. Covers golden signals, capacity/saturation, cold starts, revision rollout correlation and cost. Scope the drilldown with project_id and location for global uniqueness — GCP only guarantees service_name uniqueness within a (project, region) pair.

query.esql: ROW `Open` = "< Overview"
ROW `Open` = "< Overview"

embeddableConfig.description: Navigation tile — returns to the Cloud Run services overview dashboard, carrying the current time range.

Identity strip for the service currently in focus, showing its name, GCP region and project. Service names are only unique within a project and region, so use all three when correlating with the GCP console.

TS metrics-gcp.cloudrun.otel-default
| WHERE TRANGE(?_tstart, ?_tend)
| STATS service_name = MAX(resource.attributes.service_name),
        location = MAX(resource.attributes.location),
        project_id = MAX(resource.attributes.project_id)
| LIMIT 1

embeddableConfig.description: Navigation tile — opens this service's raw metric documents in Discover for the current time range.

Saturation summary for the selected service, showing CPU and memory utilisation percentiles over the range. p95 CPU above 80% or p95 memory above 70% indicates the service is near its resource limits and may throttle or OOM.
esql_query:
FROM metrics-gcp.cloudrun.otel-default
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend
| STATS
    mem_p50 = PERCENTILE(`metrics.run.googleapis.com/container/memory/utilizations`::exponential_histogram, 50),
    mem_p95 = PERCENTILE(`metrics.run.googleapis.com/container/memory/utilizations`::exponential_histogram, 95),
    mem_p99 = PERCENTILE(`metrics.run.googleapis.com/container/memory/utilizations`::exponential_histogram, 99),
    cpu_p50 = PERCENTILE(`metrics.run.googleapis.com/container/cpu/utilizations`::exponential_histogram, 50),
    cpu_p95 = PERCENTILE(`metrics.run.googleapis.com/container/cpu/utilizations`::exponential_histogram, 95),
    cpu_p99 = PERCENTILE(`metrics.run.googleapis.com/container/cpu/utilizations`::exponential_histogram, 99),
    max_active = MAX(`metrics.run.googleapis.com/container/instance_count`) WHERE attributes.state == "active"
    BY service_name = resource.attributes.service_name,
       location = resource.attributes.location,
       project_id = resource.attributes.project_id
| SORT mem_p95 DESC
| LIMIT 1
